use_checkpointing_mixin_resume: use CheckpointingMixin to resume a PyTorch training job from a saved checkpoint file
use_remove_prefix_from_model: use remove_prefix_from_model to strip the module. prefix from a PyTorch state dict
use_save_model_atomic: use save_model to atomically save a PyTorch model checkpoint to avoid corruption on crash
use_requeue_handler_slurm: use requeueHandler to handle Slurm SIGUSR1 preemption signals and trigger job requeue
use_end_of_epoch_hook: use end_of_epoch_hook to automatically save model and runinfo at the end of each training epoch
